name: common
description: General-purpose Codex utilities for prompt work, measurable goals, bounded delegation, strategic execution, plain-language recovery, and large decision maps. Skill instructions stay in English; user-facing prose and newly generated human-readable artifacts default to Traditional Chinese unless the user explicitly requests another language.

interface.shortDescription: Developer workflows with Traditional Chinese output by default
interface.longDescription: Common bundles better-prompts, define-goal, delegate, strategic-advance, wait-what, and Wayfinder with grilling, domain-modeling, research, and prototype. It helps improve prompts, pin measurable outcomes, delegate verifiable slices, keep long-running cross-tool work advancing, recover explanations that did not land, and chart multi-session decisions. Skill instructions remain English; user-facing prose and new human-readable artifacts default to Traditional Chinese unless another language is explicitly requested.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $better-prompts to improve this prompt while preserving its intent and constraints.
